one_month_reasoning: Dycom's Q3 FY27 report is expected around 2026-11-23 (Earnings Whispers, unconfirmed), i.e. after the 2026-11-08 window, so no company earnings fall inside it. In-window items: (1) Loudoun County Board resolution on 2026-10-20 enacting the up-to-12-month pause on legislative data-center/substation approvals retroactive to 2026-09-15 (Loudoun release) - telegraphed for a month, by-right projects unaffected, mild headline risk for Building Systems; (2) late-October AT&T and Verizon Q3 reports, now read through the 2026-10-09 SpaceX-Grain 800 MHz spectrum deal that knocked carriers 5.5-7.4% premarket while lifting towers (Reuters) - a mixed read for DY's wireless/wireline work; (3) hyperscaler and peer contractor Q3 results. Short-horizon regularities pull both ways: post-earnings drift and weak momentum (weekly returns -25.1% w/e Aug 28, -5.1% and -7.0% in the two September weeks; Chartrow) against reversal potential after a ~52% drawdown and small open-market insider buys at $281-297. No directional edge, so I keep a symmetric lognormal centred at ~$270 with log-sigma 0.15 (52% annual / 3.5), unchanged from round 1.

bear.story: Communications run-rate stays flat after the wireless recapture (H2 FY27 implied ~flat y/y), the early-March FY28 outlook lands well below the $20.78 consensus (~$17.5), DMV pauses spread from legislative approvals into Building Systems awards, and the supplier-finance build starts to reverse so FCF disappoints and leverage stays near 2.9x. ~11x on ~$17.5-18 EPS: ~$195.

base.story: Backlog ($12.2B, NTM $6.5B) converts; FY27 near the $17.05 consensus and an FY28 outlook framing ~$20 EPS including the ~$150M deferred wireless revenue. The multiple recovers only partly (~14x NTM EPS ~$21.4) because leverage, carrier concentration and cash-flow quality keep a discount: ~$300.

bull.story: Long-haul/hyperscaler awards enter backlog, BEAD construction ramps in 2027, Building Systems keeps high-teens/low-20s margins with NTM backlog >$1.1B, FCF turns clean as receivables collect, and the multiple re-rates to ~20x (MasTec's current NTM level) on NTM EPS ~$21.5: ~$430.

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: Discount, argued on verified factors that persist through Oct-2027: (1) leverage: net debt/TTM EBITDA 2.90x for DY vs 2.23x for MTZ (StockAnalysis); (2) concentration: AT&T, Verizon and Lumen were 35.8% of Q2 FY27 revenue (10-Q; 50.2% in FY26), on carrier programs whose timing just moved ~$150M of wireless revenue into FY28; (3) cash-flow quality: supplier-finance obligations went from $0 (Jul-2025) to $367.4M (Aug-2026) and H1 FY27 FCF was still about -$54M, so reported FCF overstates the repeatable base; (4) Building Systems is concentrated in the Greater Washington DC/MD/VA market where Loudoun, Prince William, Prince George's, Montgomery and both state governors have moved to pause or tighten data-center approvals (Venable, Loudoun). Growth does not justify a discount (DY next-year EPS growth 19.68% vs 11-peer median 19.36%, Finviz) and the amortization add-back is not a reason either, so the discount is held at ~20% to MTZ rather than widened to today's ~27%. [Citation gate 2026-10-12] Leverage from filings: lease-inclusive net debt / company-adjusted TTM EBITDA 2.82x for DY ($2,708.3M / $959.8M) vs 2.12x for MTZ ($2,919.8M / $1,379.5M); 2.58x vs 1.76x ex leases. FY26 AT&T + Verizon + Lumen = 50.2% (10-K). 'DY next-year EPS growth 19.68% vs 11-peer median 19.36%' is Finviz consensus growth (page reopened, matches).

thesis_break_reason: $205 is ~9.9x FY28 consensus EPS ($20.78), ~9.6x my horizon NTM EPS ($21.38), and ~22% below the $263.36 52-week low. A close there would most likely mean an earnings reset (FY28 EPS in the mid-teens), not ordinary 52%-vol noise. Triggers: an early-March 2027 FY28 outlook implying flat-to-down EPS or Communications declining even with the ~$150M wireless recapture; a program cut at AT&T or Verizon (now ~30% of revenue together); Building Systems NTM backlog (currently $1.11B) shrinking as DMV pauses reach awards; or the $367M supplier-finance build reversing and pushing FCF and leverage the wrong way. Covenant stress is not a near-term channel: the maintenance covenant is 4.50x net leverage (4.00x from early 2028) vs ~2.3x pro forma, with $746M of revolver availability (10-Q).

key_uncertainties: Whether H2 FY27 Communications flatness is timing (wireless deferral) or a cycle peak; the FY28 outlook in March 2027 decides it.
Cash-flow quality: how much of FY26/TTM operating cash flow is supplier-finance timing ($0 to $367.4M in a year) and how much of H1 FY27's -$54M FCF is growth working capital that reverses in H2.
How far DMV data-center pauses reach into Building Systems awards vs only new legislative approvals; whether moratoria spread to other states (Polymarket: Indiana 10.5%, Texas 19.5% by end-2027).
Carrier spending after the SpaceX-Grain spectrum deal and AT&T's absorption of Lumen's mass-markets fiber business (AT&T + Verizon + Lumen = 35.8% of Q2 revenue).
Momentum and positioning: the stock halved from $566 while peers held high multiples, so sentiment rather than estimates drives much of the variance.
Research limits: Reddit and X were not reachable in round 1; peer forward EV/EBITDA is not available from an open source (trailing used instead).
reasoning: Round 2. The supervisor's evidence-backed findings, re-checked at source, change three things. (1) Cash quality: supplier-finance obligations rose from $0 to $367.4M (XBRL), FY26 operating cash flow included a $223.2M AP build (10-K), and H1 FY27 FCF was about -$54M (10-Q: OCF 79.1 - capex 139.8 + proceeds 6.5). My round-1 P/FCF leg (30%) used flattered TTM FCF, so I dropped it and replaced it with a trailing EV/EBITDA leg on a vendor-consistent basis (Finviz/StockAnalysis lease-inclusive EV, TTM EBITDA $932M) with lease-inclusive net debt and slower de-leveraging (~$200M over 14 months). (2) Multiple: DY's net debt/EBITDA 2.90x vs MTZ 2.23x (StockAnalysis, verified), so 17x is too close to MTZ's 19.89x NTM; I moved to 16x (~20% discount) and applied the same 20% discount on EV/EBITDA (12.4x vs MTZ 15.47x). I also corrected the NTM weighting to 0.31 FY28 / 0.69 FY29 (NTM EPS $21.38 after a 5% haircut). P/E $342, EV/EBITDA $367, blend $352 vs $356 in round 1. I disagree mildly with the supervisor's $334 EV/EBITDA leg: it applies 10x to NTM adjusted EBITDA, which is ~35% below MTZ's trailing multiple on a forward basis; on a like-for-like trailing basis the 20% discount gives 12.4x. (3) Facts: customer concentration is 35.8% of Q2 revenue (10-Q), not ~50%; the supervisor reports the August Communications guide cut as the ~$150M deferral plus only ~$10M underlying (I confirmed the ~$150M deferral and the $5.90-6.01B guide in the Q2 release but did not re-open the Q1 release, so this enters no number); the covenant is 4.50x, not ~3x. The DMV moratorium-to-price link is demoted to context: a re-openable weekly series (Chartrow) shows the July decline was spread over several weeks starting before the 2026-07-22 Loudoun vote, while the earnings week was -25.1%; the September weeks (-5.1%, -7.0%) coincide with the VA/MD executive orders but that remains timing-only. Dropped thin Polymarket markets (Amazon capex, 2027 recession) and the key-gated Twelve Data series. Scenarios: bear $195 (30%), base $300 (45%), bull $430 (25%, from $440 because the bull re-rating target is MTZ's ~20x rather than the peer median); mixture of lognormals with dispersion 0.22-0.30 gives median ~$295, mean ~$310 and an effective vol in the low-40s %; I fattened both tails slightly (ladder median ~$294), below the 52% realized (inflated by the earnings gap). The fair value ($352, +31%) is not fully weighted because leverage, cash quality and DMV policy can keep the discount all year. Sell-side targets (avg $520.91) were treated as evidence of estimate levels, not the answer. Lane: 10 of 24 sources (42%) are alternative-lane kinds (Form 4 insider flow, Venable newsletters, Loudoun agenda, Polymarket, Chartrow weekly series); the rest are filings and data pages for reported facts and peer multiples, below the 60% target because Reddit/X were unreachable and this round was spent verifying the supervisor's findings at primary sources.
